comparisons.peer_summary: Citi pledged assets to collateralize obligations under repurchase agreements, secured financing agreements, secured liabilities of consolidated VIEs, and other borrowings. At December 31, 2024 and 2023, the carrying values of pledged assets that may not be sold or repledged by secured parties were $535.6 billion and $511.6 billion, respectively.
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and C disclose details on assets pledged to collateralize secured financing obligations. GS specifically breaks out 'other secured financings collateralized by financial instruments' into two components: trading assets, investments, and loans ($24.39 billion) and financial instruments received as collateral and repledged ($1.35 billion) as of Dec 2024. Similarly, Citi discloses the carrying value of pledged assets used to collateralize obligations under repurchase agreements and secured financing agreements, noting that $535.6 billion of these pledged assets may not be sold or repledged by secured parties as of Dec 2024. While GS quantifies the liabilities/funding side collateralized by specific asset classes, Citi quantifies the asset side (pledged assets) and restricts their transferability.

sentences.text: • Other secured financings collateralized by financial instruments included $24.39 billion as of December 2024 and $8.38 billion as of December 2023 of other secured financings collateralized by trading assets, investments and loans, and included $1.35 billion as of December 2024 and $1.49 billion as of December 2023 of other secured financings collateralized by financial instruments received as collateral and repledged.

In connection with Citi's financing and trading activities, Citi has pledged assets to collateralize its obligations under repurchase agreements, secured financing agreements, secured liabilities of consolidated VIEs and other borrowings.
At December 31, 2024 and 2023, $535.6 billion and $511.6 billion, respectively, of these pledged assets may not be sold or repledged by the secured parties.

comparisons.peer_topic: Definition and Scope of Other Secured Financings
comparisons.peer_summary: Other secured financings include liabilities from collateralized notes, asset transfers accounted for as financings, and consolidated VIEs where the firm is the primary beneficiary, with maturities originally exceeding one year.
comparisons.comparison: MS and GS both define 'Other secured financings' within the same accounting context. MS defines these as liabilities from collateralized notes, asset transfers accounted for as financings rather than sales, and consolidated VIEs. GS's disclosure under the specific item 'Other Secured Financings' references 'other secured financings collateralized by trading assets, investments and loans' and 'financial instruments received as collateral and repledged', which aligns with MS's definition of asset transfers accounted for as financings. Both firms treat these specific transactions as secured financings rather than outright sales.

sentences.text: • Other secured financings collateralized by financial instruments included $24.39 billion as of December 2024 and $8.38 billion as of December 2023 of other secured financings collateralized by trading assets, investments and loans, and included $1.35 billion as of December 2024 and $1.49 billion as of December 2023 of other secured financings collateralized by financial instruments received as collateral and repledged.

Other secured financings include the liabilities related to collateralized notes, transfers of financial assets that are accounted for as financings rather than sales and consolidated VIEs where the Firm is deemed to be the primary beneficiary.
